pages.title: Classic Christmas Candy Cane Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page features a classic Christmas candy cane with a rounded hook and evenly spaced diagonal bands that continue along its straight stem.

pages.title: Simple Candy Cane with Wide Stripes Coloring Page
pages.description: A rounded hook and a few wide stripes give this printable coloring page of a simple candy cane large, clearly separated sections to color.

pages.title: Blank Candy Cane Outline Coloring Page
pages.description: The blank candy cane on this printable coloring page has a thick, uninterrupted outline and one open space for drawing stripes or another pattern.

pages.title: Cute Candy Cane with a Smiling Face Coloring Page
pages.description: Two outlined eyes and a curved smile appear between the diagonal stripes of the cheerful candy cane on this printable coloring page.

pages.title: Candy Cane with a Christmas Bow Coloring Page
pages.description: A large Christmas bow with rounded loops and pointed ribbon tails is tied around the striped candy cane on this printable coloring page.

pages.title: Two Crossed Candy Canes Tied with a Bow Coloring Page
pages.description: Two striped candy canes cross behind a shared ribbon bow, with their hooks curving outward above the knot on this printable coloring page.

pages.title: Two Candy Canes Forming a Heart Coloring Page
pages.description: On this printable coloring page, two striped candy canes curl inward at the top and meet at the bottom to frame an open heart.

pages.title: Candy Cane with Holly and Berries Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows a striped candy cane resting behind a sprig of pointed holly leaves and three round berries at its base.

pages.title: Candy Cane with Jingle Bells Coloring Page
pages.description: On this printable coloring page, a striped candy cane is tied with a ribbon bow from which two jingle bells hang by short loops.

pages.title: Candy Cane with Mistletoe Coloring Page
pages.description: A sprig of mistletoe with oval leaves and three round berries is tied near the base of the striped candy cane on this printable coloring page.

pages.title: Candy Cane Wrapped in Christmas Lights Coloring Page
pages.description: On this printable coloring page, a strand of five Christmas bulbs winds around a striped candy cane, leaving clear spaces between the cord and stripes.

pages.title: Candy Cane and Peppermint Swirls Coloring Page
pages.description: Three round peppermint candies sit beside a striped candy cane on this printable coloring page, each with a pinwheel pattern that curls toward the center.

pages.title: Candy Cane and a Christmas Present Coloring Page
pages.description: A large striped candy cane leans behind a square Christmas gift with a broad ribbon and a looped bow in this printable coloring page.

pages.title: Candy Canes in a Christmas Stocking Coloring Page
pages.description: Two striped candy cane hooks peek from a stocking with a scalloped cuff, ribbon bow, and holly sprig on this printable coloring page.

pages.title: Christmas Tree Decorated with Candy Canes Coloring Page
pages.description: A five-pointed star tops the Christmas tree on this printable coloring page, and five striped candy canes hang across its three tiers of branches.

pages.title: Christmas Wreath Made of Candy Canes Coloring Page
pages.description: Six striped candy canes form the wreath on this printable coloring page, with a ribbon bow at the bottom and an open space in the center.

pages.title: Hot Chocolate with a Candy Cane Coloring Page
pages.description: A candy cane leans out of a smiling mug of hot chocolate with three marshmallows and a curl of steam on this printable coloring page.

pages.title: Candy Cane Inside a Snow Globe Coloring Page
pages.description: In this printable coloring page, a smiling candy cane stands in a snow globe with three drifting snowflakes, rounded snowbanks, and a pedestal base.

pages.title: Santa Claus Holding a Candy Cane Coloring Page
pages.description: Santa Claus holds a striped candy cane beside his curly beard, with a pompom hat and a square belt buckle on this printable coloring page.

pages.title: Christmas Elf Carrying a Candy Cane Coloring Page
pages.description: A Christmas elf carries a striped candy cane on this printable coloring page, wearing a pointed hat, striped stockings, and boots with curled toes.

pages.title: Reindeer Holding a Candy Cane Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows a reindeer holding a striped candy cane in its mouth, with branching antlers, pointed ears, and outlined hooves.

pages.title: Snowman Holding a Candy Cane Coloring Page
pages.description: A smiling snowman grips a striped candy cane with one twig arm and wears a holly-trimmed top hat on this printable coloring page.

pages.title: Gingerbread Man Holding a Candy Cane Coloring Page
pages.description: A gingerbread man holds a striped candy cane on this printable coloring page, with a bow tie, three round buttons, and wavy icing trim.

pages.title: Penguin Holding a Candy Cane Coloring Page
pages.description: A penguin wraps both flippers around a striped candy cane on this printable coloring page, with a rounded belly, a small beak, and webbed feet.

pages.title: Christmas Gnome Hugging a Candy Cane Coloring Page
pages.description: A bearded Christmas gnome hugs a striped candy cane with both mittens, wearing a tall pompom hat and sturdy boots on this printable coloring page.

pages.title: Candy Cane Sleigh Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows a Christmas sleigh with a high curved seat, a ribbon bow on its side, and striped candy cane runners.

pages.title: Candy Cane Lane in the Snow Coloring Page
pages.description: Pairs of striped candy canes line a winding path through snowdrifts, growing smaller toward a distant evergreen tree on this printable coloring page.

pages.title: Candy Cane Repeating Pattern Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page repeats sixteen striped candy canes in four rows, alternating upright canes and diagonal canes to form a regular pattern.

pages.title: Candy Cane Mandala Coloring Page
pages.description: Eight striped candy canes radiate around the center of this printable coloring page, forming a circular mandala with petal shapes in the spaces between them.

pages.title: Stained Glass Candy Cane Coloring Page
pages.description: A large striped candy cane fills the center of an arched window, surrounded by angular stained glass panes in this printable coloring page.
